# Ariadne Artifact

This repository contains the artifact for:

**Ariadne: An Efficient Deadlock-Free Temporal RDA with Local Tags and Interleaved Switching**
**MICRO 2026**

The repository includes two main components:

* `simulator/`: configuration generation, temporal CGRA simulation, and log parsing.
* `fpga/`: Vivado and Vitis projects for FPGA configuration and behavioral simulation.

## Components

### Simulator

The `simulator/` directory contains:

* `BackendCodeEmitter.scala` for generating Ariadne CGRA configurations;
* `wer2.scala` for cycle-level temporal simulation;
* `readFile.scala` for parsing simulation logs;
* benchmark graphs, mappings, and generated configurations;
* Windows and Ubuntu scripts for running the complete benchmark suite.

See [`simulator/README.md`](simulator/README.md) for detailed instructions.

### FPGA

The `fpga/` directory contains:

* the Vivado project and project archive;
* custom IP sources;
* Vivado reconstruction scripts;
* prebuilt hardware files and implementation reports;
* the exported Vitis workspace;
* a prebuilt MicroBlaze ELF;
* a reference behavioral-simulation waveform for ATAX.

See [`fpga/README.md`](fpga/README.md) for detailed configuration and simulation instructions.

## Requirements

The two components have separate software requirements.

### Simulator

* Java 11 or a compatible version
* SBT 1.x
* Scala 2.13.12
* CMD on Windows
* Bash on Ubuntu

### FPGA

* Windows 11
* Vivado 2021.1
* Vitis 2021.1
* AMD/Xilinx VCU128
* MicroBlaze

## Clone

This repository uses Git submodules for the simulator and FPGA components.

Clone the repository together with all submodules:

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules \
  https://github.com/SoftwareDefinedChipTHU/Ariadne-artifact.git
```

Then enter the repository:

```bash
cd Ariadne-artifact
```

If the repository was cloned without `--recurse-submodules`, initialize the submodules manually:

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

To update the main repository and both submodules later:

```bash
git pull
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

The repository contains:

```text
simulator/   Ariadne configuration generator and temporal simulator
fpga/        Vivado and Vitis FPGA simulation artifact
```

## Quick Start

To run the complete simulator benchmark suite:

```bash
cd simulator
chmod +x run_all_tests_ubuntu.sh
./run_all_tests_ubuntu.sh
```

On Windows:

```bat
cd simulator
run_all_tests_windows.bat
```

For FPGA behavioral simulation, follow the instructions in:

```text
fpga/README.md
```
